options.name: action
options.description: whether to get or set the parameter specified in 'option'

options.name: ceph_client
options.description: Ceph client name (``-n``) for the native ``ceph`` CLI when ``use_cephadm`` is false.

options.name: cluster
options.description: Ceph cluster name used with the native ``ceph`` CLI when ``use_cephadm`` is false.

options.name: fsid
options.description: the fsid of the Ceph cluster to interact with.

options.name: image
options.description: The Ceph container image to use.

options.name: keyring
options.description: Path to the keyring file for the native ``ceph`` CLI when ``use_cephadm`` is false. Defaults to ``/etc/ceph/<cluster>.<ceph_client>.keyring``.

options.name: option
options.description: name of the parameter to be set

options.name: use_cephadm
options.description: When true (default), run the Ceph CLI through Cephadm shell (``cephadm shell ceph ...``). When false, run the ``ceph`` binary on the target host with keyring authentication (for example Proxmox or other non-Cephadm clusters). May be set for all modules in ``group/ceph.automation.ceph_cli`` via ``module_defaults``.

options.name: who
options.description: which daemon the configuration should be set to
